derivation:
rw [Matrix.det_of_isUpperTriangular (rowOp_blockTriangular ℓ)]
refine Finset.prod_eq_one fun i _ => by simp [rowOp]
explanation: Mathlib gives the determinant as the product of diagonal entries for an upper-triangular matrix. Applied to `rowOp ℓ`, its diagonal entries simplify to 1, yielding this result.
